checks.name: catalog: 872 clips (484 in-place, 388 root) converted and decodable
pace: run is Mvm_Dash at its own speed, rate 1
pace: light stick is Mvm_Walk at its own speed, rate 1
pace: Flow sprint is Mvm_Boost at its own speed, rate 1
auto start: Mvm_Jog_Start_Fwd with root motion
auto stop: a Dash end clip brings him to rest
auto idle turn: light stick to the side turns him in place
auto turning start: stick behind plays a 180 start
auto 180 turn while running (Dash pace)
auto 90-degree arc while running
E dash, no stick: Esc_BoostDash_Back with its root travel
RB dash follows the stick in 8 directions
RB hold then release: power charge dash
E in Flow sprint: power dash
E in the air: 8-way air dash
E in the air with Jump held: upward boost dash lifts the capsule
X tumble: front handspring start and end (tap)
X held: handspring keeps springing (loop) then ends
R with stick back: back handspring
R in the air: front air roll over the physics jump
Tab strafe: right, left, back and forward loops, facing the camera
strafe starts and stops by direction
LB strafe tiers: light stick walk loop, RB held charge-dash loop
LB strafe in Flow: dash loop then boost loop at their own speeds
strafe evades: side-step, stand roll, dodge, roll
strafe evade in Flow at speed: slide start, keep, end
strafe jump to the side: Runner side jump over the physics jump
dash into a wall: blocked at the wall, never through it
dash off a ledge: handed to physics, falls and lands
contact correction never above 12 cm
wall runs: Runner wall loop on the wall's side, leaning away from the wall, both directions
G weapon mode: staff in hand, E is the weapon dash
weapon mode RT chain: weapon clips on the combat moves, hits connect
G again: weapon off, staff hidden
death while running plays a Runner death; respawn stands him up
Move List: Perform plays the chosen clip in play
Backspool control: no Runner-full actions, his own clips, E is still his Drive
no page errors
